notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.
